machine_start_gcode.default_value:
;Machine Model: {machine_name}
;Nozzle Size: {machine_nozzle_size}
;Sliced at: {day} {date} {time}
;--- Penrose 600 Swappable (Filament) Start GCode ---
M140 S{material_bed_temperature_layer_0} 	;Heat build surface
M104 T0 S{material_print_temperature_layer_0} 	;Heat nozzle
M190 S{material_bed_temperature_layer_0} 	;Wait for bed temperature
M109 T0 S{material_print_temperature_layer_0} 	;Wait for nozzle temperature
G21 ;metric values
M107 ;fan off
G28 ;home all axes
M420 S1 ;restore bed level mesh
G90 ;absolute positioning
G1 X0 Y0 Z5 F5000 ;move nozzle up 5mm for safe homing
G29 ;auto bed leveling
M500 ;save settings
M82 ;set extruder to absolute mode
M107 ;start with the fan off
G1 X{machine_width / 2 - 17.5} Y0 Z15.0 F5000 ;move to purge start (front center of bed)

; Extrude purge line
G92 E0 ;reset extruder position
G0 Z0.4 F500 ;move to purge height
G0 X{machine_width / 2 - 2.5} E2.5 F500 ;slow purge
G92 E0 ;reset extruder position
G0 X{machine_width / 2 + 7.5} E2.5 F650 ;medium purge
G92 E0 ;reset extruder position
G0 X{machine_width / 2 + 17.5} E2.5 F800 ;fast purge
G92 E0 ;reset extruder position
G0 X{machine_width / 2 + 22.5} Z{0.1} F{8000} ;wipe move close to bed
G0 X{machine_width / 2 + 27.5} Z0.4 F{8000} ;wipe move away from bed

G92 E0 ;zero the extruded length
M117 Printing...

M300 S880 P166
M300 S0 P166
M300 S880 P166
M300 S1318 P166
M300 S1567 P166
M300 S0 P166
